purpose: Research asset preview only; not a Kimi screen, native reference implementation or runtime evidence
conversionScope: Literal vector/group/path attributes, transforms, colors, alpha, strokes and fill rules only. Android dimensions retained as declarations; numeric SVG preview units do not establish dp-to-CSS-px equivalence.
